Underlined heading style produces setext-style headings for h1 and h2

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Main Title</h1>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(heading_style: 'Underlined'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
